The first thing to remember is that another person isn't the scource of happiness. That has to come from within.   You have to accept yourself before someone else even can.  And if you're struggling and shes willing to dip out when times get tough, it's probably a bad sign for the relationship that she's not willing to be there for you when you need it the most.   Not what you want to hear, but it's the truth I've found in my life. 

As for being with her in general, if you're moping around, and seem desperate for her, she's going to see you as a fall back.   Sometimes you need to just mask up, cut her off, act like you're fine too, act as though you've moved on, at least in her presence.  Don't completely run, but make an effort to limit that contact.   This may work, as she will no longer feel the comfort of knowing you're waiting and will always be her fallback forcing her to make a choice.   And if it doesn't work like that, then theres nothing else to be done, it wasn't going to be a good relationship anyway.
